effect_description_eng:
＜Retaliation＞ (When this Digimon is deleted after losing a battle, delete the Digimon it was battling.)
[On Play] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) and trash 2 cards in your hand.
[On Deletion] From your trash and without paying the cost, you may play 1 Tamer card with [Myotismon] in its text and without the same name as any of your Tamers.
